intro_html: Bright, zesty, and a little addictive, this Thai-style larb is proof that healthy prep never has to be boring. Each bowl brings 50 grams of protein for about $5.11 a serving (at everyday cost). One skillet makes 14 servings.
cost_closing_html: About $5.11 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each of the 14 bowls gives you 50 grams of protein and about 642 calories.
upsell_html: Fresh, punchy, and cheap, this is the bowl that keeps your taste buds interested all week. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: The 8 lb ground turkey pack is your best value, so buy the big size and portion it out.
A bottle of lime juice is cheaper than fresh limes for a big batch and lasts a long time in the fridge.
Fresh green peppers around a dollar each add crunch and color without much cost.
make_it: Heat a little olive oil in a large skillet and brown the ground turkey.
Add the chopped onion and green peppers and cook until they soften.
Stir in the lime juice and honey to build that classic sweet-and-sour larb balance.
Let it simmer a couple minutes so the flavors soak in, then season with salt to taste.
Serve it over cooked white rice with extra lime on the side.
